{{Top|leg}}
'''Naorstrachem''' was a highly flexible substance, which was often used in the creation of netting or webbing. Synthetic Naorstrachem was used by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] to fabricate the webbing that was shot from the [[Anti-Riot Tangle Gun 7]]. The synthetic form was often combined more readily with a shrinking agent, which was required for not only contraction of the webbing around the target, but also ease of storage within a gun.
